fieldNotes.facility: Niagara Bottling Groveland plant, 7633 American Way, operating since 2007. Confirmed via Street View: building with bulk silos/storage tanks (bottling water tanks), gated entry. Located in a multi-tenant industrial park; the Niagara building is the standalone large building, distinct from neighboring warehouses.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View up the entry driveway shows a controlled checkpoint: a gate with a stop sign, perimeter chain-link fencing across the property line, and a guard booth with a canopy beside the lane.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small canopied guard booth is clearly visible at the gate, set beside the driveway on the building side.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Docks run along the west face with a long row of angled-bay trailer parking; angled docks make exact counting hard. Estimate ~55 doors, 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in angled bays / drop rows along the west apron; honest overhead estimate 10-25 dropped trailers.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from perimeter box (~350m N-S x ~340m E-W); ~42 acres.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The gated driveway runs a long distance from the public road up the west side; ample queue depth inside the gate.
